# Inner City Law Center

> > Legal aid organization providing free legal services to combat homelessness and preserve housing stability in Los Angeles' Skid Row and beyond.

Founded by Nancy Mintie, ICLC has evolved from serving Skid Row tenants at the Catholic Worker soup kitchen to becoming a leading advocate for tenant rights, eviction defense, and homeless legal services throughout Los Angeles. The organization works on housing litigation, legislative advocacy, and programs like Bringing Families Home to prevent and end homelessness.

## Key Topics

- Tenant Rights
- Eviction Defense
- Homelessness Prevention
- Skid Row
- Housing Stability
- Legal Aid
- Pro Bono Services
- Housing Litigation
- Legislative Advocacy
- Section 8 Housing
- TAHO (Tenant Anti-Harassment Ordinance)
- Veterans Services
- Nancy Mintie (Founder)
- Los Angeles Housing Policy

## Programs & Legal Services

- [Bringing Families Home](https://innercitylaw.org/areas-of-work/bringing-families-home): Program preventing family homelessness through eviction defense and Section 8
